snippet.title: Saturn Longplay [013] Seifuku Densetsu: Pretty Fighter X (JP)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: Valis77

This is an enhanced port of the snes game of the same name. This version features four additional characters, added a FMV intro and ending for each character as well as altered graphics and audio; and a sequel known as FIST, which had little success in Japan for its low ratings.

I chose the main default character and the second playthrough i played as the final boss. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
